matches.rationale: All of these findings converge on the same root mathematical error: the paper's claim that β^Tβ's eigenvalue set differs between the left-identity (p=I⊗i) and right-identity (p=i⊗I) cases, whereas Lean confirms the eigenvalues (and hence M) are always identical. Pred 2 pinpoints Eq. 8 directly, Pred 3 traces the error into Eq. 9's conditions, Pred 4 shows the Theorem 1.4 proof inherits the refuted eqs. 8-9, Pred 1 proves the general charpoly identity invalidating the whole swap-asymmetry construction, and Pred 7 restates this same invariance fact (M(ρ)=M(ρ')) as it resurfaces in the Conclusion — satisfying R3's symptom-elsewhere permissiveness.
